name: Domain Reasoning Matrix & Visual Style Taxonomy: 192 Archetype Profiles, 79 Aesthetic Styles & Multi-Dial Parameter Tuning
description: Exhaustive design intelligence architecture integrating 192 domain reasoning profiles, 79 vetted aesthetic UI styles (Soft UI, Neo-Brutalism, Swiss Editorial, Dark Glassmorphism, Kinetic Minimal), 119 UX heuristics across a 10-tier priority ladder, 74 font pairings, and a multi-dial parameter engine (variance, motion intensity, content density) across 22 technology stacks.
designPhilosophy: Replace generic AI design guessing with deterministic, domain-specific reasoning rules that pair brand archetypes with calibrated typography scales, semantic tokens, and layout density.
appropriateUseCases: Autonomous design system scaffolding for new web applications
Design audit and anti-pattern remediation across enterprise platforms
Conversion-optimized landing pages and SaaS product dashboards
Multi-platform responsive interfaces across React, Vue, Next.js, Svelte, Tailwind, and native frameworks
implementationApproach: Follow the 10-tier priority ladder (Data Integrity -> Feasibility -> User Flow -> Accessibility -> Usability -> Ergonomics -> Performance -> Hierarchy -> Motion -> Delight) and calibrate visual tokens using variance (1-10), motion (1-10), and density (1-10) dials.
performanceConsiderations: Enforce strict layout performance: pre-reserve image dimensions (CLS < 0.05), clamp backdrop blur under 28px, avoid layout thrashing on animated containers, and honor prefers-reduced-motion.
accessibilityRequirements: Enforce minimum 4.5:1 text contrast, visible 2px keyboard focus indicators, 44x44px minimum touch targets, aria-labels for icon-only buttons, and zero unrequested audio (Silent by Default).
